Critical values of the exact adaptive test

Source: R/rosenbaum-pairs.R
riposte_adaptive_critical.Rd

With I1 pairs in the top lambda[1] fraction of ranks of |y| and I2 in the next band, B1, B2 count positive differences, and T = 2*B1 + B2. Under the sensitivity bound they are independent binomials with success probability kappa = gamma / (1 + gamma). The test rejects when B1 >= kB or T >= kT, where (kB, kT) satisfy conditions (4)-(6) of the paper: size at most alpha, neither constant can be lowered by one without exceeding alpha, and |P(B1 >= kB) - P(T >= kT)| is minimized. Ties in the minimization go to the smaller kB, as in the paper.

Usage

riposte_adaptive_critical(I1, I2, gamma = 1, alpha = 0.05)

Arguments

I1, I2

band sizes.

gamma

sensitivity parameter, >= 1.

alpha

level.

Value

a list with kB, kT, size (P(reject)), pB (P(B1 >= kB)), pT.
